metadata.host_selection_rule: storage-only: direct child contract with most references; lexical canonical-id tie-break

semantics.projection_rule: Studio Everyday/Expose projects #SHOP data but does not own it.
semantics.identity_rule: List, item, candidate product, merchant cart/order and payment identities remain distinct.
semantics.action_rule: List/item edits invoke #SHOP operations; external cart/order/payment uses separate authorized operations.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing/selecting candidate products grants no purchase authority.
semantics.ranking_rule: Recommendations/rankings are derived evidence and never canonical purchase decisions.
semantics.redaction_rule: Sensitive account/order/payment data is redacted according to policy.
semantics.failure_rule: Unavailable products/prices or failed orders are shown explicitly rather than synthesized.

invariants.rule: Shopping-list data expresses planning intent only; list/item existence, ranking, recommendation or selection never authorizes purchase, payment or external order execution.

hard_gates.condition: monitor conflates list and merchant cart

references.purpose: Shopping may be exposed through Everyday.
